headline: Philippine inflation accelerates in September; experts expect central bank to raise rates again
summary: The central bank said September inflation could reach 6.4% to 7.4%, the seventh straight month above its 3% target. Experts said peso weakness could prompt another rate increase.
why: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas sets the policy rate for the Philippines, and inflation and rate decisions drive local bond yields and the peso.
